hypotheses.direction: Long gap-up accepted sessions; short gap-down accepted sessions.
hypotheses.entry_event: First completed bar after 09:30 acceptance confirmation.
hypotheses.hypothesis_name: Gap acceptance continuation after completed first-15-minute confirmation
hypotheses.invalidation: Price closes back through prior close before entry or opening range midpoint fails acceptance.
hypotheses.known_prior_research: Related to opening drive and ORB, but distinct because trigger is prior-close gap acceptance after first-15-minute confirmation, not opening-range breakout/retest.
hypotheses.legal_entry_timestamp: 09:31 IST or first next completed one-minute timestamp after acceptance.
hypotheses.material_distinction_from_prior_work: Uses overnight inventory acceptance relative to prior close, not generic ORB breakout or raw opening impulse.
hypotheses.negative_expectation_falsifier: No positive WFA mean, fewer than 4 positive folds, or controls match/exceed signal.
hypotheses.parameter_ownership: session mechanics and round completed-bar structure

parameter_units.minimum_abs_gap_bps: basis points from prior close to open

hypotheses.participants_or_behavior: Overnight inventory adjustment, index futures hedging, and intraday trend followers adding after the first accepted opening range.
hypotheses.persistence_rationale: Opening auction displacement often forces benchmark and intraday participants to transact in the gap direction when price stays outside the prior close area.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Direction-normalized underlying return from legal entry close to +30 completed minutes, clipped at session end.
hypotheses.required_data: Underlying one-minute OHLC candles for NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, SENSEX; prior-session close; completed first 15 one-minute bars.
setup_state_machine: LOAD prior complete session close
WAIT for first 15 completed bars
MEASURE gap from prior close to session open
ACCEPT if 09:30 close remains beyond 50% of gap in gap direction and above/below opening range midpoint
EMIT once at first legal bar after acceptance
hypotheses.single_emission_rule: At most one candidate per symbol-session.
hypotheses.structural_premise: A directional overnight gap that is accepted after the opening range reflects inventory repricing rather than immediate mean reversion.

hypotheses.direction: Short failed gap-up; long failed gap-down.
hypotheses.entry_event: First completed close showing rejection after 09:30 and before 10:15.
hypotheses.hypothesis_name: Gap rejection reversal after failed first-30-minute acceptance
hypotheses.invalidation: Gap resumes beyond opening extreme before entry.
hypotheses.known_prior_research: Related to mean reversion but not generic VWAP extension; premise is failed overnight gap inventory.
hypotheses.legal_entry_timestamp: Next completed one-minute timestamp after rejection close.
hypotheses.material_distinction_from_prior_work: Candidate identity depends on prior-close gap failure, not stretch-from-VWAP or ORB retest.
hypotheses.negative_expectation_falsifier: Reversal returns fail WFA/control separation or are concentrated in few sessions.
hypotheses.participants_or_behavior: Opening gap chasers unwind; liquidity providers fade failed displacement; hedgers reduce directional exposure.
hypotheses.persistence_rationale: Failed gap acceptance creates predictable inventory pain when price crosses back through prior close/opening midpoint.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Direction-normalized underlying return from legal entry close to +45 completed minutes.
hypotheses.required_data: Underlying one-minute OHLC candles; prior-session close; completed first 30 bars.
setup_state_machine: LOAD prior close
WAIT for gap open and first 30 completed bars
REJECT if price closes back inside 25% of prior-close gap or crosses prior close
EMIT reversal at first completed rejection close
hypotheses.single_emission_rule: At most one candidate per symbol-session.
hypotheses.structural_premise: A gap that cannot hold through the first 30 minutes indicates trapped directional open inventory and mean reversion pressure.

hypotheses.direction: Long after sweep below prior low and reclaim; short after sweep above prior high and reclaim.
hypotheses.entry_event: First completed reclaim close after sweep.
hypotheses.invalidation: Second close beyond swept extreme before entry.
hypotheses.known_prior_research: Distinct from ORB and VWAP; uses previous session extrema as liquidity pools.
hypotheses.legal_entry_timestamp: Next completed one-minute timestamp after reclaim.
hypotheses.material_distinction_from_prior_work: Candidate is anchored on prior-day high/low stop-run failure rather than opening range or VWAP state.
hypotheses.negative_expectation_falsifier: Reclaim does not outperform matched random entries around prior-day levels.
hypotheses.participants_or_behavior: Stop orders and breakout liquidity are absorbed; trapped breakout traders unwind; stronger hands reclaim value.
hypotheses.persistence_rationale: Prior-day extremes are visible liquidity pools; failed auction beyond them can create short-horizon directional flow.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Direction-normalized underlying return from entry to +30 completed minutes.
hypotheses.required_data: Underlying one-minute OHLC candles for current and prior complete session.
setup_state_machine: LOAD prior-day high and low
WAIT for current session sweep beyond level by minimum bps
REQUIRE completed close back inside prior range
EMIT away from swept level on next bar
hypotheses.single_emission_rule: At most one high sweep and one low sweep per symbol-session; first side only if both occur.
hypotheses.structural_premise: A sweep beyond prior-day high/low followed by reclaim marks failed stop-run liquidity and continuation away from the swept level.

hypotheses.direction: Long upside escape; short downside escape.
hypotheses.entry_event: First completed accepted close outside narrow opening balance.
hypotheses.invalidation: Close back inside opening range before entry.
hypotheses.known_prior_research: Related to compression breakout but distinct because compression is first-30-minute market balance width, not indicator compression score.
hypotheses.legal_entry_timestamp: Next completed one-minute timestamp after escape close.
hypotheses.material_distinction_from_prior_work: Uses explicit opening-balance geometry and acceptance rather than generic volatility/compression score.
hypotheses.negative_expectation_falsifier: No WFA-positive expansion after narrow balances or controls indistinguishable.
hypotheses.participants_or_behavior: Liquidity builds inside early balance; breakout participants and hedgers transact after accepted escape.
hypotheses.persistence_rationale: Compression followed by acceptance is a market-structure transition, not an indicator combination.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Direction-normalized underlying return to +60 completed minutes.
hypotheses.required_data: Underlying one-minute OHLC; first 30-minute range; same-session bars after 09:45.
setup_state_machine: WAIT first 30 completed bars
CLASSIFY narrow if opening range width <= 35 bps of open
WAIT close outside opening range by 20% of range
EMIT in escape direction next bar
hypotheses.single_emission_rule: At most one candidate per symbol-session.
hypotheses.structural_premise: Unusually narrow first-30-minute range stores intraday energy; a later accepted escape can continue as balance resolves.

hypotheses.direction: Long if leader and laggard both close above first-30-minute range; short if both close below.
hypotheses.hypothesis_name: Cross-index leader escape followed by laggard continuation
hypotheses.invalidation: Leader closes back inside its opening range before confirmation.
hypotheses.known_prior_research: Distinct from single-symbol ORB/retest because identity requires cross-index lead-lag sequencing.
hypotheses.legal_entry_timestamp: Next completed one-minute timestamp after cross-index confirmation.
hypotheses.material_distinction_from_prior_work: The causal object is market-wide transmission, not a standalone breakout.
hypotheses.negative_expectation_falsifier: Lag confirmation fails WFA/control separation or leader-only control matches it.
hypotheses.participants_or_behavior: Index arbitrage, basket hedging, and sector/index rotation transmit directional pressure across NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, and SENSEX.
hypotheses.persistence_rationale: Cross-index confirmation filters idiosyncratic noise and captures broad index-flow alignment.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Equal-weight direction-normalized underlying return across confirmed symbols to +45 completed minutes.
hypotheses.required_data: Synchronized one-minute underlying OHLC for all three indices.
setup_state_machine: WAIT first 30 completed bars for all symbols
IDENTIFY first index to close outside its opening range
WAIT up to 15 minutes for second index confirmation same direction
EMIT on confirming laggard and optionally evaluate all aligned symbols
hypotheses.single_emission_rule: At most one market-wide candidate per session.
hypotheses.structural_premise: When one index escapes its opening balance and another confirms with lag, broad-market flow is more durable than single-index noise.

multiple_testing_control: Holm-Bonferroni familywise alpha 0.05 across all frozen hypotheses in all cycles
